requirements.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:14,23,31,39,49-52 (fillable, slug route key, memberships/users/owner relations); app/Models/EntityMembership.php:14,24-29,50-71 (fillable, UserRole cast, owner/admin/employee scopes); app/Models/UserRole.php:16-18 (manageable => [Admin, Employee]); app/Models/User.php:24-47 (memberships, entities, membershipFor); database/migrations/2026_10_29_045537_create_entities_table.php:17-19 (named slug unique + soft deletes); database/migrations/2026_10_29_045538_create_entity_memberships_table.php:16-35 (cascade FKs, role default, stored owner_seq and both named unique indexes); app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:14-49 and app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:14-41 implement every ability; docs/database-schema.md:31-37,90-91,151-152,164 updated.

conventions.evidence: Eloquent attributes plus deliberate fillable (app/Models/Entity.php:14, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:14), generator-style migrations with reversible down() (database/migrations/2026_10_29_045537_create_entities_table.php:26-29 and ...045538_create_entity_memberships_table.php:42-45), authorization in app/Policies/*, sibling Laravel docblock style, and docs kept in sync (docs/database-schema.md:149-152, docs/README.md:13, CHANGELOG.md:12).

security.evidence: Every policy resolves the caller's membership server-side (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:54-59, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:46-51); the owner membership is never deletable (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:30-34); Entity fillable excludes owner_seq (app/Models/Entity.php:14) and membership fillable is limited to entity_id/user_id/role; the diff adds no request input or unescaped output.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:14-181 covers factories, schema/index names, relations, scopes, generated owner_seq, unique constraints, cascades and soft deletes; tests/Feature/EntityPolicyTest.php:26-97 and tests/Feature/EntityMembershipPolicyTest.php:21-109 cover allow and deny paths for every ability plus Gate auto-discovery.

simplicity.evidence: Small models and policies with no new layers or speculative abstractions, but the identical membership-role lookup is duplicated in app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:54-59 and app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:46-51.

readability.evidence: Short focused methods, clear names and consistent Laravel-style docblocks (app/Models/Entity.php:20-53, app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:11-49); no dead code, debug output or inconsistent style.

scope.evidence: The diff only adds the entity domain (enum, models, factories, migrations, policies, tests) and the required doc/CHANGELOG updates (docs/database-schema.md, docs/README.md:13, CHANGELOG.md:12); no routes, pages or session handling.

issues.explanation: The owner_seq test asserts only the computed value, which a virtual generated column would also satisfy, so it cannot catch a regression from storedAs() to virtualAs() despite the task explicitly requiring a stored column.
Both policies implement the same 'role of this user in this entity' query and in_array check; a shared helper (e.g. on User) would remove the duplication.
The entities ER block also drops the planned locale_default column, which matches the implemented table but is an extra doc edit beyond the owner_membership_id change the task called out.

review.summary: The change implements the full entity/entity-membership data model end to end: migrations with the generated owner_seq column and both named unique indexes, the UserRole enum, Entity/EntityMembership/User relations, factories, both policies, extensive Pest coverage, and the required doc and changelog updates. It meets the task and conventions with no security gaps; the overall 4 reflects only nits, chiefly that the test suite does not pin the column as stored and the role lookup is duplicated across the two policies.
